schema_kind: data dictionary, not a JSON Schema validator
id_join_key: id (train-00000 through train-07472); join by string, never row order

values.1: wrong numeric answer OR parse failure

checkpoint_definition: t generated answer tokens already in context; before predicting zero-based generated token t (human token t+1)
checkpoint_availability: t < generated_tokens; missing checkpoints have no row, not zero/NaN padding
trajectory_layers: 1..28; array index l-1 is transition h_(l-1) -> h_l; h_0 is embedding output

dimensions.B: problems in batch, normally 32; last batch 17
dimensions.C: sum of available checkpoint counts across B problems

ids.meaning: problem ID for each checkpoint row; repeats across checkpoints

hidden.meaning: raw block outputs BEFORE final RMSNorm; axis 1 follows raw_layers

trajectory.meaning: all layer transitions at checkpoint; for early prediction slice [:14], never full 28

readout_ids.meaning: one problem ID per ragged readout segment

readout_offsets.meaning: segment i = readouts[offsets[i]:offsets[i+1]]; begins at t0; offsets[0]=0, offsets[-1]=R

readouts.meaning: logit-lens statistics at every position 0..min(128,L-1), not just checkpoints; axes readout_layers/readout_metrics

formulas.margin: largest probability minus second-largest probability; NOT logit gap
formulas.top1_probability: max_v p_l[v]; next-token peak, NOT answer correctness probability

generation.prompt_token_ids: integer list, rendered system/user chat + assistant generation prefix
generation.generated_token_ids: integer list, model's own greedy path, not gold teacher forcing
generation.text: decoded answer with special tokens skipped
generation.prompt_tokens: prompt length, metadata; not an internal feature
generation.generated_tokens: L, final answer length; future leakage at t0/t32/etc
generation.effective_generation_config: effective generation settings; optional extra legacy fields may exist

label.gold_number: Decimal-compatible string parsed from gold final line
label.predicted_number: Decimal-compatible string or null on parse failure
label.answer_correct: boolean; parsed numeric equality, NOT proof of valid reasoning
label.truncated: boolean, separately recorded; does not independently force a wrong label
label.analysis_eligible: parse_status == ok AND not truncated; optional retrospective sensitivity subset

summary.origin: new_train, old_pilot, old_exploration, old_confirmation; provenance, NOT split/predictor
summary.quality: positions, matches, causal_max_abs_error; replay diagnostics, NOT predictors

questions_record.index: zero-based official train index at pinned revision
questions_record.question: original question text
questions_record.gold: full original worked solution and #### numeric answer; forbidden predictor

derived_views.problem_index.jsonl: one row/problem: id,batch,question_group_sha256,origin,incorrect,answer_correct,parse_status,truncated,analysis_eligible,generated_tokens,available_checkpoints; metadata and target, not feature matrix
derived_views.question_group_sha256: SHA256(UTF8(' '.join(question.split()))); whitespace-only normalization, not semantic deduplication
derived_views.scalar_features_t0_t32.jsonl: one row/problem: id, incorrect, features.t0 (36 floats), features.t32 (36 floats or null if unavailable)
derived_views.scalar_precision: derived in float64 from saved float32 readouts; JSON numbers; NOT new inference or past trained features
derived_views.samples.json: small original question/gold + generation records + t0/t32 convenience features; no raw hidden vectors

early_feature_allowlist: trajectory at chosen t: layers 1..14 only
derived scalar values using ONLY those readouts
split_policy: No train/validation/test split shipped. Full train pool includes previous fitting/tuning/confirmation examples. Group by normalized question before freezing a new split. Official test not included.
